messages.message:
Patch Set 1:

(1 comment)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Mostly good, one minor comment inline. The canmount=noauto change matches OpenZFS 2.2+ behaviour: changelist_postfix() only auto-mounts when the refreshed canmount reads 'on', and an explicit 'zfs mount <dataset>' still mounts a noauto dataset, so the test also keeps working on older ZFS.

commit.message:
LU-18652 tests: re-enable conf-sanity/108a on ZFS

Since OpenZFS 2.2 setting the mountpoint of a canmount=on dataset
also mounts it, so the explicit "zfs mount" in test_108a fails with
"filesystem already mounted". Use canmount=noauto so only the
explicit mount happens, and drop 108a from the always_except list.

Test-Parameters: trivial testlist=conf-sanity env=ONLY=108a fstype=zfs
Signed-off-by: Robert Read <rread@thelustrecollective.com>
